scope: Finite independent text review of frozen Kernel and FileView. The reviewer authored OwnerOps and does not independently clear it; its close_journal call is cited only to establish the cross-module interface defect.

findings.observation: entry requires the exact SyntheticRawBackend type, which defines invoke_reserved only. KernelState passes that object to _BootstrapPrimitives, whose __post_init__ requires a callable invoke attribute.
findings.consequence: Every otherwise-valid entry fails with KernelRefusal(INVALID_INPUT) during Core construction, before attempt.state is assigned. The downstream interface/raw-publication paths cannot be reached through the valid entry API until this mismatch is corrected.
findings.evidence_kind: Source text only; no actual failure or probe was performed by this reviewer.

findings.observation: The stable SinkFacade exports close, while the adapted late finalizer calls self.sink.close_journal. No close_journal member exists on the facade.
findings.consequence: After the earlier entry blocker is corrected, late finalization would raise AttributeError instead of forwarding the single journal-close callback, preventing the required completion sequence.
findings.evidence_kind: Source text only; no actual failure or probe was performed by this reviewer.

findings.observation: AdoptionHooks assigns c.scalar/count/error/error_definition before raw_store.observe completes. A failure after native staging but before commit latches/stops the call, yet _reconcile_native only imports committed values into previously UNOBSERVED fields; it does not remove the already-assigned Python value or require its axis to be committed. handle, defined and canonical reporting continue to derive facts from those Python fields.
findings.consequence: An uncommitted native scalar may still grant a usable handle/cleanup right through c.scalar; the analogous count cache may appear defined. The raw bank retains staged/unknown state, so the two representations disagree about which value is authoritative. Preserving staged payload for diagnosis must not promote it into a known ownership/count fact.
findings.boundary: The correction must distinguish canonical committed bank facts from any separately retained Python delivery evidence, preserve staged bits and original errors, and retain cleanup only for genuinely known committed rights. This review does not prescribe new APIs or authorize edits.
findings.evidence_kind: Source text only. Root independently reported this defect before this record; no actual failure or probe was performed by this reviewer.

other_finite_review_groups.result: No additional static finding. Valid-path first sample precedes plan/helper work; Origin is created from that exact retained sample, and canonical Registry/raw store/facades are constructed before admission. This is conditional on correcting F1 and on the explicitly prebound interpreter/entry TCB; it is not a production first-entry proof.

No additional static finding. Namespace scalar and callback ACK are retained before the post-clock gate; reservation_ready is set only after ownership/ACK checks. Original reservation and capture require that barrier, so a partial namespace failure does not authorize an original open.

No additional static finding. Snapshot rows copy exact 256-byte records and immutable Python facts; getters read copied values without a clock or live bank access. Capture and final assembly sample the original cleanup clock, retain partial/error state, and veto pure acknowledgement/result issuance on incomplete or late capture. The declared copies remain an explicit allocation, not measured RSS.

No additional static finding. The closed loader checks declared captured/trusted dependencies, retains the executing kernel object, and has no filesystem/module-cache fallback. Claim/install/late dispatch check the original captured table object and 18 ordered function identities; views retain the same State/Origin/nonce/Registry/raw store. Actual source execution and namespace-adversarial tests remain pending.

No additional independent FileView finding. It validates the actual kernel namespace, claimed StateView and canonical refs and delegates to the existing bootstrap primitives. Close uses the original hard clock and consumes the close-reserved right before dispatch, with no retry of false/unknown close outcomes. F2 blocks journal finalization; F3 can incorrectly manufacture the precondition for a close and must be corrected before this lifecycle can be accepted.
